### How this work is cited

Passages inside Discours sur le colonialisme are identified by section of the discourse. A single continuous polemic without chapters, so the archive cites a described section rather than a number.

### The work in Aimé Césaire’s thought

Aimé Césaire (1913–2008) was a Martinican poet, dramatist, and politician who coined ‘Négritude’ in the 1930s. Notebook of a Return to the Native Land and Discourse on Colonialism couple poetic revolt with a philosophical indictment of European colonial civilization. [More on Aimé Césaire](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/aime-cesaire) .
